create.name: Prairie Zen Center
create.bio:
Prairie Zen Center is a small Zen community in Champaign, Illinois, belonging to the Ordinary Mind Zen School that grew from the teaching of Charlotte Joko Beck, whom it honours as its founder. Its guiding teacher is Elihu Genmyo Smith Roshi, Joko Beck's first dharma heir, who began Zen training in 1974, co-founded the Ordinary Mind school and now visits from California to lead retreats. Ed Mushin Russell, Genmyo's dharma heir since 2015, is the resident teacher.

The practice is plain and direct: zazen facing the wall, walking meditation, a short service and a Sunday talk, with private interviews with a teacher. Sittings run on weekday mornings, Thursday evening and Sunday morning, and everything on the weekly schedule can also be joined over Zoom. About five sesshin a year, of three to five days, are led by the two teachers, and newcomers can ask for an introduction to sitting either in person or online. Recordings of the Sunday talks are posted on its YouTube channel and as audio on its website, together with written teachings and a free book by Genmyo.

courses.title: Rohatsu Sesshin
courses.description: The December retreat at the Champaign centre, led by Elihu Genmyo Smith, with full days of zazen and teacher interviews; part-time attendance and joining by Zoom are both possible.
courses.price: Suggested donation: attendance via Zoom is $25 per day; attendance at PZC is $40 per day and includes meals, without meals $30 per day

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Membership supports the centre and keeps an ongoing connection with a teacher, with a discount on sesshin fees; pledges are set by each member's means.
courses.price: Local members $40/Mo.; out of town members $25/Mo.

free_resources.title: Weekly practice (in person and on Zoom)
free_resources.description: Weekday morning sittings, a Thursday evening sitting and a Sunday morning programme of zazen, service and a talk, open at the centre or by Zoom link on request.

free_resources.title: Zazen Instruction
free_resources.description: Step-by-step guidance on how to sit, from posture and breath to the forms of the zendo, with a monthly introduction offered at the centre or over Zoom.

free_resources.title: Dharma Audio & Text
free_resources.description: Recorded Sunday and sesshin talks by Genmyo and Mushin to stream or download, with short written teachings, verses and articles.

free_resources.title: Ordinary Life, Wondrous Life (free PDF)
free_resources.description: A book of Zen teachings by Elihu Genmyo Smith, published by the centre and offered as a free download.
